g.title: Notes
g.text: Crow's foot notation: bar = exactly one; foot = many; circle =
Grey / dashed = base-structure tables still absent from the code.
Accounts: user_account (+ role_id) and profiles with PK = FK
The buyer (seat_hold, orders, payment, ticket) is participant_profile.
Types follow the base structure (UUID); Sprint 2 code uses Integer.
States are VARCHAR with CHECK, using the code enum values.
event_seat: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on hold; ticket: partial unique
FKs not drawn (redundant or to tables not shown):
Not shown: refresh_token, password_reset_token, seat_zone, seat_type,
«orders»: «order» is a reserved word in SQL.
